update_md5_ad7488414f06eece5ac555eae7385.name: continue_nonprovider_tool_after_stop
update_md5_ad7488414f06eece5ac555eae7385.semantics: Provider finish labels are not authoritative for non-provider-executed tool parts. Continue exactly when a pending tool result must be returned to the model; keep provider-executed stop turns terminal.
update_md5_ad7488414f06eece5ac555eae7385.content_md5_ad7488414f06eece5ac555eae738: if (msg.finish === "tool-calls" || MessageV2.parts(msg.id).some((part) => part.type === "tool" && !part.metadata?.providerExecuted)) return "continue" as const
